conservation_retry_method: fresh Cantera CVODE on identical initial state, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-24; reject only if still inadmissible
normalization: preserve sampled N2; proportionally normalize all other log-sampled weights to 1-N2
reference_method: Cantera CVODE, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-20; documented reactor reset inside each independently seeded shard
